_comment: Third Genie meeting (Level 3, Map 2 / Raby). Triggered at l3-map2-lamp-active; Genie entity l3-map2-genie is revealed then removed by DialogueSystem on finish; lamp swaps to l3-map2-lamp-used.
title: Third Meeting

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: You're getting closer. I can feel him now.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: He's called the Wish Eater. Every wish he takes makes him stronger.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: He didn't just capture her… he bound her to his power.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: As long as he exists, she cannot escape.

lines.speaker: genie
lines.text: Be careful. He'll try to break you… make you doubt your own wishes.
